path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Claims and Rewards›PA ST 32 P.S. § 283. Hearing and determination
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Claims and Rewards › PA ST 32 P.S. § 283. Hearing and determination
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 283. Hearing and determination (2023)
content:
The said Board shall hear and determine all such claims, and if in any case the Board
   is of the opinion that a moral claim exists against the Commonwealth for any such
   injury or death, and that such claim is not properly adjustable or cannot then be
   adjusted under the workmen's compensation laws, it shall make a finding to that effect,
   and shall fix the sum which in its opinion will compensate the parent, parents, or
   dependent relative or relatives of the person killed or the person seriously injured.  Any amount so fixed by the Board shall be payable from the appropriation hereinbefore
   made by warrant of the Auditor General, after requisition by the Secretary of Forests
   and Waters,1and to each such requisition shall be attached the findings of the Board.  The action of the Board in allowing or disapproving a claim shall be final and there
   shall be no appeal therefrom, but the Board in its discretion may grant rehearings
   on any claim and make any new findings, in accordance with this act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Claims and Rewards›PA ST 32 P.S. § 282. Presentation to Board of Finance and Revenue
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Claims and Rewards › PA ST 32 P.S. § 282. Presentation to Board of Finance and Revenue
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 282. Presentation to Board of Finance and Revenue (2023)
content:
Any such parent or dependent relative of any person heretofore or hereafter killed,
   or any such person heretofore or hereafter seriously injured while fighting fires,
   as provided in section one of this act,1may present a claim therefor to the Board of Finance and Revenue, and for the purpose
   of hearing and adjusting such claims the Secretary of Forests and Waters2shall become a member of said Board with full powers of a member thereof.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Purchase by Department of Forests and Waters or Board of Game Commissioners›PA ST 32 P.S. § 182. Return of taxes on redemption
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Purchase by Department of Forests and Waters or Board of Game Commissioners › PA ST 32 P.S. § 182. Return of taxes on redemption
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 182. Return of taxes on redemption (2023)
content:
Upon the redemption of any such lands, the amount paid to the county treasurer for
   taxes, penalties, interest and costs by the person redeeming such lands shall be for
   the use of the Commonwealth, and shall, immediately upon receipt, be transmitted by
   the county treasurer to the Department of Forests and Waters1for payment into the State Treasury, through the Department of Revenue, and to the
   Board of Game Commissioners2for deposit in the Game Fund.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Expenses›PA ST 32 P.S. § 316. Forest fire defined
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Expenses › PA ST 32 P.S. § 316. Forest fire defined
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 316. Forest fire defined (2023)
content:
The term“forest fire,”as used in this act, is intended to include fires which burn in woods, farmers' woodlots,
   marshes, brush barrens, brush lands, and wild, unseated, uncultivated land.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Expenses›PA ST 32 P.S. § 312. Time for presenting bills
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Expenses › PA ST 32 P.S. § 312. Time for presenting bills
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 312. Time for presenting bills (2023)
content:
No bills of expense relating to the protection of forests from fire, incurred under
   this act, shall be honored by the chief forest fire-warden unless presented to him
   within sixty days after the expense has been incurred.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Expenses›PA ST 32 P.S. § 315. Suits to recover expenses; disposition of moneys recovered
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Expenses › PA ST 32 P.S. § 315. Suits to recover expenses; disposition of moneys recovered
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 315. Suits to recover expenses; disposition of moneys recovered (2023)
content:
The Department of Justice, acting for and on behalf of the Department of Forests and
   Waters,1may recover the expenses incurred by the latter department on account of any forest
   fire, from the person liable for payment of such expenses, by instituting, in the
   name of the Commonwealth, an action of assumpsit in any county in which the defendant
   can be served with process, but no such action shall be brought unless the person
   liable for the payment of such expenses has failed to pay the same within thirty days
   after receiving a bill therefor from the Department of Forests and Waters.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Expenses›PA ST 32 P.S. § 313. Duties of Auditor General
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Expenses › PA ST 32 P.S. § 313. Duties of Auditor General
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 313. Duties of Auditor General (2023)
content:
The Auditor General shall satisfy himself as to the correctness of all bills transmitted
   to him by the Commissioner of Forestry1for expense incurred under this act, and shall then draw his warrants against the
   general forest protection appropriation in favor of the persons and for the amounts
   shown by the approved bills.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Claims and Rewards›PA ST 32 P.S. § 284. Rewards
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Claims and Rewards › PA ST 32 P.S. § 284. Rewards
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 284. Rewards (2023)
content:
The Department of Forestry1is authorized to offer and to pay rewards for evidence leading to the arrest and
   conviction of any person who maliciously sets fire to any woodlot, forest, or wild
   land.  When such evidence is obtained by any local forest fire warden during time for which
   said warden shall not have been otherwise paid, the Department of Forestry is authorized
   to pay, from its appropriation, the amount of said reward to said fire warden.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Expenses›PA ST 32 P.S. § 314. Persons causing forest fire liable for expenses
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Expenses › PA ST 32 P.S. § 314. Persons causing forest fire liable for expenses
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 314. Persons causing forest fire liable for expenses (2023)
content:
From and after the passage of this act, every person causing a forest fire within
   this Commonwealth, directly or by the act of an agent or employe, shall be liable
   to the Commonwealth for all expenses incurred by the Department of Forests and Waters1on account of such fire.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Penalties›PA ST 32 P.S. § 345. Penalty for mutilating notices
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Penalties › PA ST 32 P.S. § 345. Penalty for mutilating notices
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 345. Penalty for mutilating notices (2023)
content:
Any person who shall, without authority, destroy, deface, or remove any notice, sign,
   or poster of the Department of Forests and Waters,1posted for the better protection of woodlots, forests, or wild lands from fire, shall,
   upon conviction thereof in a summary proceeding before any magistrate, alderman, or
   justice of the peace, be sentenced to pay a fine not exceeding ten dollars, and, in
   default of the payment of such fine and costs, be imprisoned in the county jail one
   day for each dollar of fine and costs unpaid.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Expenses›PA ST 32 P.S. § 317. Person defined
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Expenses › PA ST 32 P.S. § 317. Person defined
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 317. Person defined (2023)
content:
The term“person,”as used in this act, shall include individuals, associations, copartnerships, and
   corporations, and their officers, agents, or employes.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Penalties›PA ST 32 P.S. § 343. Penalty for hindering an officer in his duties
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Penalties › PA ST 32 P.S. § 343. Penalty for hindering an officer in his duties
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 343. Penalty for hindering an officer in his duties (2023)
content:
A person who shall prevent or obstruct, or attempt to prevent or obstruct, a fire
   warden or ex officio fire warden in the performance of a duty required by this act,
   or the exercise of the rights of entry, access, or examination by any warden or officer
   of this bureau, shall, upon conviction in a summary proceeding before any magistrate,
   alderman, or justice of the peace, be sentenced to pay a fine not exceeding one hundred
   dollars, and, in default of the payment of such fine and costs, be imprisoned in the
   county jail one day for each dollar of fine and costs unpaid, not, however, exceeding
   thirty days.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Penalties›PA ST 32 P.S. § 344. Penalty for causing fire on or within woodlots, forests, or wild lands; definitions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Penalties › PA ST 32 P.S. § 344. Penalty for causing fire on or within woodlots, forests, or wild lands; definitions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 344. Penalty for causing fire on or within woodlots, forests, or wild lands; definitions (2023)
content:
(a) It shall be unlawful for any person to set fire to, or to cause to be set on fire,
      either accidentally or otherwise, directly or indirectly, in person or by agent, any
      woodlot, forest, or wild land, or property, material, or vegetation being or growing
      thereon, without permission of the owner, either by dropping lighted matches, tobacco,
      or other substances, or in any other manner whatsoever;  or to start fires anywhere
      and permit them to spread to woodlots, forest, or wild land, thereby causing damage
      to or destruction of such property, as aforesaid.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Penalties›PA ST 32 P.S. § 342. Penalty for refusing to aid a fire-warden
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Penalties › PA ST 32 P.S. § 342. Penalty for refusing to aid a fire-warden
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 342. Penalty for refusing to aid a fire-warden (2023)
content:
If any fire warden, being in need of assistance in the suppression of fire, shall
   call upon any person to render assistance, and such person shall refuse without a
   just and fair excuse he shall, upon conviction in a summary proceeding before any
   magistrate, alderman, or justice of the peace, be sentenced to pay a fine not exceeding
   one hundred dollars, and, in default of the payment of such fine and costs, be imprisoned
   in the county jail one day for each dollar of fine and costs unpaid, not, however,
   exceeding thirty days.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Cooperation in Prevention of Fires›PA ST 32 P.S. § 391. With local fire associations; expenditures; patrols
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Cooperation in Prevention of Fires › PA ST 32 P.S. § 391. With local fire associations; expenditures; patrols
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 391. With local fire associations; expenditures; patrols (2023)
content:
The Department of Forestry1is hereby authorized to enter into co-operative agreements with local forest fire
   associations, within this Commonwealth, for the prevention and suppression of forest
   fires;  and is hereby authorized to expend, from its general forest fire appropriation,
   for this purpose, a sum of money equal in amount to the amount which shall be expended
   by each local association for the employment of proper persons to patrol such lands
   during those danger seasons of the year known as the forest fire seasons, and for
   such period of time each season as, in the judgment of the local association and the
   department, it is necessary or expedient to maintain such regular patrol;  and under
   such terms and conditions made with such local associations as, in the judgment of
   said department, will produce the best and most satisfactory results in the prevention
   and suppression of forest fires:  Provided, That such expenditure by the department
   shall not exceed thirty dollars per month for each patrolman.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Definitions›PA ST 32 P.S. § 371. Definitions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Definitions › PA ST 32 P.S. § 371. Definitions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 371. Definitions (2023)
content:
(a) The term“person,”as used in this act, shall include not only individuals or natural persons, but as
      well artificial persons existing only in contemplation of law, and shall be construed
      to mean associations, partnerships, limited partnerships, joint stock companies, and
      corporations, and their officers, agents, and employés.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Penalties›PA ST 32 P.S. § 346. Disposition of fines
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Penalties › PA ST 32 P.S. § 346. Disposition of fines
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 346. Disposition of fines (2023)
content:
Moneys received from the payment of fines shall be paid to the treasurer of the county
   in which suit is brought, for the use of the county, except as otherwise provided
   in this act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Penalties›PA ST 32 P.S. § 341. Penalty for neglect of duty; false statements
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Penalties › PA ST 32 P.S. § 341. Penalty for neglect of duty; false statements
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 341. Penalty for neglect of duty; false statements (2023)
content:
If a fire warden shall fail to perform his duty, or shall render a false or fraudulent
   statement of service alleged to have been performed, or shall fail to pay promptly
   the respective amounts due those who have rendered service, after said amounts have
   been transmitted to him, he shall be guilty of a misdemeanor, and upon conviction
   thereof shall be fined a sum not exceeding five hundred dollars, or undergo imprisonment
   not exceeding six months, or both, in the discretion of the court.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Cooperation with States and Federal Government›PA ST 32 P.S. § 397. Environmental Resources Department; exchange of employees and equipment
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Cooperation with States and Federal Government › PA ST 32 P.S. § 397. Environmental Resources Department; exchange of employees and equipment
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 397. Environmental Resources Department; exchange of employees and equipment (2023)
content:
The Department of Environmental Resources1may upon request of any other state or the United States, forward to or receive therefrom,
   for use under the supervision of such department, except as otherwise provided herein,
   such of its employees and equipment as it deems necessary to assist in the protection
   of forests from the ravages of fire.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Cooperation in Prevention of Fires›PA ST 32 P.S. § 394. Organization of associations
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Cooperation in Prevention of Fires › PA ST 32 P.S. § 394. Organization of associations
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 394. Organization of associations (2023)
content:
When any group of land owners desire to organize themselves into a mutual forest fire
   protective association they shall promptly notify the Commissioner of Forestry1of their intent, if it be the desire of such land owners to avail themselves of the
   benefits of this act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Cooperation with States and Federal Government›PA ST 32 P.S. § 400. Payment of travel and other expenses of out-of-state employees and equipment
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Cooperation with States and Federal Government › PA ST 32 P.S. § 400. Payment of travel and other expenses of out-of-state employees and equipment
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 400. Payment of travel and other expenses of out-of-state employees and equipment (2023)
content:
The Department of Environmental Resources1shall, in accordance with its regulations, pay those travel and other expenses of
   employees or equipment of other states or Federal agencies detailed to assist it in
   forest fire protection in Pennsylvania incurred in the performance of their work assignments
   while in this Commonwealth provided such payment is requested by the assisting states,
   groups of states or Federal agency.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Cooperation in Prevention of Fires›PA ST 32 P.S. § 393. Fire seasons not limited
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Cooperation in Prevention of Fires › PA ST 32 P.S. § 393. Fire seasons not limited
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 393. Fire seasons not limited (2023)
content:
The fire seasons hereinabove mentioned shall not be construed, by reason of the act
   to which this act is a supplement, as being limited to the periods of time stated
   in the eighteenth section thereof.1

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Cooperation with States and Federal Government›PA ST 32 P.S. § 398. Supervision and status of employees and equipment
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Cooperation with States and Federal Government › PA ST 32 P.S. § 398. Supervision and status of employees and equipment
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 398. Supervision and status of employees and equipment (2023)
content:
Employees of the Department of Environmental Resources,1during their detail to another state or Federal agency to fight forest fires, shall
   be considered, for all purposes, to be working in the Commonwealth for that department.  The supervision of their duties during such detail may, however, be governed by
   agreement between the department and the state, group of states, or Federal agency
   to which they are detailed.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Cooperation in Prevention of Fires›PA ST 32 P.S. § 395. Forest protection; Department of Forest and Waters authorized to enter into agreements with United States
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Cooperation in Prevention of Fires › PA ST 32 P.S. § 395. Forest protection; Department of Forest and Waters authorized to enter into agreements with United States
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 395. Forest protection; Department of Forest and Waters authorized to enter into agreements with United States (2023)
content:
The Department of Forests and Waters1is hereby empowered and authorized to cooperate and enter into cooperative agreements
   with, and to receive contributions from, the United States government for the protection
   from fire, or other casualty, the development and the production of forests and forest
   producing lands.  All contributions received hereunder from the United States government shall be
   paid into the State Treasury, through the Department of Revenue, and credited to the
   biennial appropriations to the Department of Forests and Waters for the same purposes
   for which the contributions were made.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Cooperation with States and Federal Government›PA ST 32 P.S. § 399. Payment of travel and living expenses to employees in out-of-state assignments
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Cooperation with States and Federal Government › PA ST 32 P.S. § 399. Payment of travel and living expenses to employees in out-of-state assignments
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 399. Payment of travel and living expenses to employees in out-of-state assignments (2023)
content:
The Department of Environmental Resources1may, in accordance with the travel regulations of such agency, pay the travel expenses
   of the employees detailed to another state or Federal agency, and may pay travel or
   living expenses of such employees incurred in connection with their work assignments
   in the receiving state or area of Federal responsibility.  The department may request reimbursement from any state, groups of states or Federal
   agency requesting assistance for any loss or damage or expense incurred in the operations
   of any equipment, and for the cost of all materials, transportation wages, salaries
   and maintenance of employees and equipment incurred in connection with such a request.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Miscellaneous›PA ST 32 P.S. § 421. Investigation of matters other than fires
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Miscellaneous › PA ST 32 P.S. § 421. Investigation of matters other than fires
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 421. Investigation of matters other than fires (2023)
content:
When, in the judgment of the Commissioner of Forestry,1he deems it necessary for general forest protection that causes or agencies injurious
   to trees and forests, other than fire, be investigated, reported upon, or abated,
   he is hereby authorized to assign to the Bureau of Forest Protection1persons competent for such work.  The salaries of such persons, so assigned, shall be fixed by the Commissioner of
   Forestry, and shall in no case exceed the ordinary and usual amount paid for such
   services.  Salaries and expenses shall be paid out of the general forest protection appropriation.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Cooperation in Prevention of Fires›PA ST 32 P.S. § 392. Reports; suspension of activities
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Cooperation in Prevention of Fires › PA ST 32 P.S. § 392. Reports; suspension of activities
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 392. Reports; suspension of activities (2023)
content:
Every such local forest fire protection association shall render to the Department
   of Forestry,1at the end of each calendar year, a report showing the number of acres of land comprised
   within the activities of the association, and an itemized statement of all receipts
   and expenditures during the year for which the report is rendered.  And in case no appropriation shall be made by the Legislature for forest fire and
   protective work at any future time, all such co-operative agreements, subsisting at
   that time, shall be construed as being suspended during such interval for which no
   appropriation is made.  Said local association shall also report any general results of the work that the
   Commissioner of Forestry may desire.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 21. Water Power and Water Supply Permits›PA ST 32 P.S. § 592. Power dams or changes in streams within jurisdiction of United States; limitation of period of power permit; extension and renewal; conditions of permit, annual charges; terms, etc., imposed; suspension of provisions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 21. Water Power and Water Supply Permits › PA ST 32 P.S. § 592. Power dams or changes in streams within jurisdiction of United States; limitation of period of power permit; extension and renewal; conditions of permit, annual charges; terms, etc., imposed; suspension of provisions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 592. Power dams or changes in streams within jurisdiction of United States; limitation of period of power permit; extension and renewal; conditions of permit, annual charges; terms, etc., imposed; suspension of provisions (2023)
content:
A power dam or change in stream to develop power shall be deemed to be within the
   jurisdiction of the United States, within the meaning of this section, whenever (1)
   such dam or change is constructed or made, or to be constructed or made, in or upon
   navigable waters of the United States, or (2) the Federal Power Commission shall have
   found that the interests of interstate or foreign commerce would be affected by the
   construction of such dam or the making of such change.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 21. Water Power and Water Supply Permits›PA ST 32 P.S. § 591. Definitions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 21. Water Power and Water Supply Permits › PA ST 32 P.S. § 591. Definitions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 591. Definitions (2023)
content:
Where used in this act singular words shall be construed as including the plural,
   masculine words shall be construed as including the feminine and neuter, and the following
   words shall have the following meanings respectively designated for each:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Middle Atlantic Interstate Forest Fire Protection Compact›PA ST 32 P.S. § 423. When compact operative; exchange of documents
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Middle Atlantic Interstate Forest Fire Protection Compact › PA ST 32 P.S. § 423. When compact operative; exchange of documents
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 423. When compact operative; exchange of documents (2023)
content:
When the Governor shall have executed said compact on behalf of this Commonwealth
   and shall have caused a verified copy thereof to be filed with the Secretary of the
   Commonwealth, and when said compact shall have been authorized by the Legislature
   and executed by the Governor of one or more of the States named in section one of
   this act,1then said compact shall become operative and effective as between this Commonwealth
   and such other State or States.  The governor is hereby authorized and directed to take such action as may be necessary
   to complete the exchange of official documents as between this Commonwealth and any
   other State authorizing said compact.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Middle Atlantic Interstate Forest Fire Protection Compact›PA ST 32 P.S. § 424. Compact administrator
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Middle Atlantic Interstate Forest Fire Protection Compact › PA ST 32 P.S. § 424. Compact administrator
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 424. Compact administrator (2023)
content:
The Secretary of Conservation and Natural Resources, or someone designated by him,
   shall act as compact administrator for the Commonwealth and represent the Commonwealth
   in the Middle Atlantic Interstate Forest Fire Protection Compact.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Cooperation with States and Federal Government›PA ST 32 P.S. § 396. Purpose and policy
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Cooperation with States and Federal Government › PA ST 32 P.S. § 396. Purpose and policy
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 396. Purpose and policy (2023)
content:
The preservation of the part of the earth's surface occupied by this Commonwealth
   is of vital concern to the people of Pennsylvania.  Similar concerns are held by the citizens of other states.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 21. Water Power and Water Supply Permits›PA ST 32 P.S. § 593.1. Disposition of moneys
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 21. Water Power and Water Supply Permits › PA ST 32 P.S. § 593.1. Disposition of moneys
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 593.1. Disposition of moneys (2023)
content:
All moneys hereafter received by the Treasury Department from the Department of Revenue,
   arising from the annual charges on limited power permits and limited water supply
   permits, as provided in the two preceding sections, shall be credited to the State
   Forests and Waters Fund1.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 21. Water Power and Water Supply Permits›PA ST 32 P.S. § 596. Previously granted permits
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 21. Water Power and Water Supply Permits › PA ST 32 P.S. § 596. Previously granted permits
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 596. Previously granted permits (2023)
content:
The provisions of this act shall not be construed as affecting any permit or authority
   heretofore granted or given pursuant to law for the construction of any dam, or for
   the changing or diminution of the course, current, or cross-section of any stream
   or body of water;  but the holder of any such permit or authority may apply for a
   limited power permit or a limited water supply permit under this act, and, if and
   when any such applicant is granted the same, he shall have all the rights and be subject
   to all the duties conferred or imposed by or under this act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part I. Forests›Chapter 7. Forest Fires›Middle Atlantic Interstate Forest Fire Protection Compact›PA ST 32 P.S. § 422. Execution of compact authorized; text of compact
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part I. Forests › Chapter 7. Forest Fires › Middle Atlantic Interstate Forest Fire Protection Compact › PA ST 32 P.S. § 422. Execution of compact authorized; text of compact
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 422. Execution of compact authorized; text of compact (2023)
content:
The Governor of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania is hereby authorized and directed
   to execute a compact on behalf of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania with any one or
   more of the States of Delaware, Maryland, New Jersey, Virginia and West Virginia,
   and with such other states as may enter into the compact legally joining therein,
   who may, by their legislative bodies, so authorize a compact, in form substantially
   as follows:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 21. Water Power and Water Supply Permits›PA ST 32 P.S. § 598. Attorney General's duties; revocation of permit
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 21. Water Power and Water Supply Permits › PA ST 32 P.S. § 598. Attorney General's duties; revocation of permit
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 598. Attorney General's duties; revocation of permit (2023)
content:
The Attorney General may, on the request of the commission,1institute proceedings in any court now or hereafter by law clothed with jurisdiction
   in civil cases in which the Commonwealth is a party for the purpose of remedying or
   correcting, by injunction, mandamus, or other process, any action of commission or
   omission in violation of the provisions of this act, or of the terms, conditions,
   or stipulations of any limited power permit or limited water supply permit granted
   hereunder, or of any lawful regulation or order promulgated hereunder.  In the event of the failure of any permittee to comply with the requirements of
   any final decree in any such proceedings, the Attorney General may institute proceedings
   for the purpose of revoking the permit.  The said courts shall have jurisdiction over all the above-mentioned proceedings,
   and shall have power to issue and execute all necessary process, and to make and enforce
   all rights, orders, and decrees to compel compliance with the lawful orders and regulations
   of the commission in respect of any so permitted dam or appurtenant works, and in
   respect of any so permitted change or diminution of the course, current, or cross-section
   of any stream or body of water, and to compel the performance of any condition imposed
   under the provisions of this act.  In the event a decree revoking a permit is entered, the court is empowered to sell
   the whole or any part of the dam, together with any or all works, lands, and water
   rights appurtenant thereto or existing under the permit, to wind up the business of
   such permittee conducted in connection with such dam, change, or diminution, to distribute
   the proceeds to the parties entitled to the same, and to make and enforce such further
   orders and decrees as equity and justice may require.  At such sale or sales, the vendee shall take the rights and privileges belonging
   to the permittee, and shall perform the duties of such permittee and assume all outstanding
   obligations and liabilities of the permittee which the court may deem equitable in
   the premises.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 21. Water Power and Water Supply Permits›PA ST 32 P.S. § 594. Restrictions on use of dams, etc., for certain purposes
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 21. Water Power and Water Supply Permits › PA ST 32 P.S. § 594. Restrictions on use of dams, etc., for certain purposes
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 594. Restrictions on use of dams, etc., for certain purposes (2023)
content:
It shall be unlawful for any corporation or natural person to use for the development
   of water power, or for the main purpose of storing, cooling, diverting, and using,
   or any of them, water for steam raising or steam condensation, or both, in the generation
   of electric energy for use in public service, any dam constructed under any permit
   hereafter issued otherwise than under section two of this act,1or to divert or use for said purposes, or for said main purpose, any stream or body
   of water the course, current, or cross-section of which shall have been changed or
   diminished at the point of diversion, or use, under any permit hereafter granted,
   otherwise than under section two of this act.1

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 21. Water Power and Water Supply Permits›PA ST 32 P.S. § 599. Powers of Public Service Commission not affected
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 21. Water Power and Water Supply Permits › PA ST 32 P.S. § 599. Powers of Public Service Commission not affected
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 599. Powers of Public Service Commission not affected (2023)
content:
Nothing in this act shall be construed to deprive the Public Service Commission of
   the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania1of any jurisdiction, powers, or duties now vested in it by the laws of the Commonwealth.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 21. Water Power and Water Supply Permits›PA ST 32 P.S. § 595. Overflow, etc., of certain lands by permittee
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 21. Water Power and Water Supply Permits › PA ST 32 P.S. § 595. Overflow, etc., of certain lands by permittee
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 595. Overflow, etc., of certain lands by permittee (2023)
content:
Any permittee holding a permit granted under section 2 of this act1may, with the consent of the commission,2which consent may be set forth in such permit, overflow, submerge, occupy, and use,
   as appurtenant to the power project in behalf of which such permit is granted, and
   subject to the terms, stipulations, and conditions expressed therein, any island owned
   by the Commonwealth in the river Susquehanna, or any of its branches, or in any other
   stream or water over which the commission has jurisdiction.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Public Service Companies›PA ST 32 P.S. § 621. Public service companies holding power and water supply permits; definitions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Public Service Companies › PA ST 32 P.S. § 621. Public service companies holding power and water supply permits; definitions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 621. Public service companies holding power and water supply permits; definitions (2023)
content:
Where used in this act singular words shall be construed as including the plural,
   masculine words shall be construed as including the feminine and neuter, and the following
   terms shall have the following meanings respectively designated for each:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 21. Water Power and Water Supply Permits›PA ST 32 P.S. § 593. Limited water supply permit; annual charge; terms, etc.
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 21. Water Power and Water Supply Permits › PA ST 32 P.S. § 593. Limited water supply permit; annual charge; terms, etc.
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 593. Limited water supply permit; annual charge; terms, etc. (2023)
content:
The commission1in granting every limited water supply permit shall specify a reasonable annual charge,
   in an amount fixed by the commission, to be paid by the permittee for the purpose
   of reimbursing the Commonwealth for the cost of administration of this act, and the
   commission shall embody therein such other terms, conditions, and stipulations as
   the commission shall deem necessary and proper to protect the present and future interests
   of the Commonwealth and its people in the construction, maintenance, and operation
   of the project and in the water resources to be utilized thereby.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Public Service Companies›PA ST 32 P.S. § 623. Appropriation and condemnation of lands, waters, etc.
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Public Service Companies › PA ST 32 P.S. § 623. Appropriation and condemnation of lands, waters, etc.
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 623. Appropriation and condemnation of lands, waters, etc. (2023)
content:
Any public service company holding a limited power permit or a limited water supply
   permit, granted on behalf of a power project or a water supply project for use in
   public service, shall have the right and power to condemn and appropriate any lands,
   waters, and other property and rights, as to which the said commission,1after due notice and public hearing, shall have found that the appropriation of the
   same is required by the present and future interests of the Commonwealth for the construction,
   maintenance, or operation of the project in behalf of which such permit is granted,
   and is not incompatible with the public interests of the region in the vicinity of
   such project.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Public Service Companies›PA ST 32 P.S. § 622. Appropriation, condemnation, etc., of streets, roads, etc.
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Public Service Companies › PA ST 32 P.S. § 622. Appropriation, condemnation, etc., of streets, roads, etc.
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 622. Appropriation, condemnation, etc., of streets, roads, etc. (2023)
content:
Any public service company holding a limited power permit or a limited water supply
   permit, granted on behalf of a power project or a water supply project for use in
   public service, shall have the right and power to appropriate and condemn, overflow,
   submerge, occupy, and use any street, road, lane, alley, turnpike, highway, bridge,
   electric railroad, or steam railroad, whether publicly or privately owned, which the
   commission1shall find to be necessary for the construction, maintenance, or operation of the
   power project or water supply project in behalf of which such permit was granted:
   Provided, That such permittee shall cause the same, and all structures of other public
   service companies located thereon, to be reconstructed, at his own proper expense,
   on such location and in such manner and to such extent as the commission may require,
   or shall reimburse such other public service company for the reasonable cost of such
   relocation and reconstruction, and such permittee may condemn and appropriate property
   which the commission shall find to be necessary for such relocation and reconstruction.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 21A. Chain Dam Hydroelectric Facility Leasing Act›PA ST 32 P.S. § 629.1. Short title
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 21A. Chain Dam Hydroelectric Facility Leasing Act › PA ST 32 P.S. § 629.1. Short title
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 629.1. Short title (2023)
content:
This act shall be known and may be cited as the Chain Dam Hydroelectric Facility Leasing
   Act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 21. Water Power and Water Supply Permits›PA ST 32 P.S. § 600. Amendment and repeal of act
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 21. Water Power and Water Supply Permits › PA ST 32 P.S. § 600. Amendment and repeal of act
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 600. Amendment and repeal of act (2023)
content:
The right to amend and repeal this act is hereby expressly reserved, but no such alteration,
   amendment, or repeal shall effect1any permit theretofore issued under the provisions of this act, or the rights of
   any permittee thereunder.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 21. Water Power and Water Supply Permits›PA ST 32 P.S. § 597. Rules and regulations
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 21. Water Power and Water Supply Permits › PA ST 32 P.S. § 597. Rules and regulations
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 597. Rules and regulations (2023)
content:
The commission1is hereby authorized and empowered to make such rules and regulations, and issue
   such orders, as may be necessary and proper for carrying out the provisions of this
   act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Public Service Companies›PA ST 32 P.S. § 624. Damages from exercise of powers conferred
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Public Service Companies › PA ST 32 P.S. § 624. Damages from exercise of powers conferred
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 624. Damages from exercise of powers conferred (2023)
content:
All damages arising from the exercise of the right and power of condemnation conferred
   by section two and three of this act1shall be ascertained, recovered, and paid as provided by the forty-first section
   of the act, approved April twenty-ninth, one thousand eight hundred and seventy-four
   (Pamphlet Laws, seventy-three), and the amendments and supplements thereto.2

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 22. Water Rights›PA ST 32 P.S. § 631. Definitions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 22. Water Rights › PA ST 32 P.S. § 631. Definitions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 631. Definitions (2023)
content:
Hereafter in this act the following words and phrases shall be understood to have
   the meanings herein set forth, unless a contrary or different meaning be clearly indicated
   by the context.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 21A. Chain Dam Hydroelectric Facility Leasing Act›PA ST 32 P.S. § 629.2. Declaration of policy
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 21A. Chain Dam Hydroelectric Facility Leasing Act › PA ST 32 P.S. § 629.2. Declaration of policy
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 629.2. Declaration of policy (2023)
content:
Because the Commonwealth currently is holding an exemption from the Federal Energy
   Regulatory Commission, which will expire before such broader legislation can be enacted,
   it is imperative that the Department of Environmental Resources be authorized to lease
   the hydroelectric facility located at Chain Dam on the Lehigh River.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 21A. Chain Dam Hydroelectric Facility Leasing Act›PA ST 32 P.S. § 629.4. Leasing of hydroelectric facilities by the department
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 21A. Chain Dam Hydroelectric Facility Leasing Act › PA ST 32 P.S. § 629.4. Leasing of hydroelectric facilities by the department
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 629.4. Leasing of hydroelectric facilities by the department (2023)
content:
(a) Authority of department.--The department shall have the power to grant to any person a hydroelectric franchise
      and any necessary right-of-way or lease for the construction, operation and maintenance
      of a hydroelectric facility utilizing the lands, water rights or facilities of the
      Commonwealth at Chain Dam, Lehigh River, Northampton County.  Any such grant affecting lands or facilities of the City of Easton shall be subject
      to the agreement and approval of the City of Easton.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 21A. Chain Dam Hydroelectric Facility Leasing Act›PA ST 32 P.S. § 629.3. Definitions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 21A. Chain Dam Hydroelectric Facility Leasing Act › PA ST 32 P.S. § 629.3. Definitions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 629.3. Definitions (2023)
content:
The following words and phrases when used in this act shall have the meanings given
   to them in this section unless the context clearly indicates otherwise:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Public Service Companies›PA ST 32 P.S. § 625. Restriction on use of systems acquired under act
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Public Service Companies › PA ST 32 P.S. § 625. Restriction on use of systems acquired under act
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 625. Restriction on use of systems acquired under act (2023)
content:
None of the rights and powers conferred by this act shall be so used as to permit
   the utilization of any system of distribution, acquired, constructed, erected, used,
   or operated through the power of condemnation or appropriation conferred by this act,
   to supply, or commence to supply, within the limits of any city, borough, township,
   or district, in which, at the time of said commencement or proposed commencement,
   a company incorporated for the supply of light, heat, and power, or any of them, to
   the public by electricity is lawfully supplying light, heat, and power by electricity,
   without first securing a certificate of public convenience from the Public Service
   Commission of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania1authorizing such use within such limits.  Nor shall this act be construed as impairing or limiting any right or power of eminent
   domain otherwise conferred by law.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 22. Water Rights›PA ST 32 P.S. § 633. Acquisition of water rights by public water supply agency, necessity of production of records supporting claims
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 22. Water Rights › PA ST 32 P.S. § 633. Acquisition of water rights by public water supply agency, necessity of production of records supporting claims
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 633. Acquisition of water rights by public water supply agency, necessity of production of records supporting claims (2023)
content:
No acquisition of water rights from a source of supply by any public water supply
   agency shall be effective to prevent the acquisition of water rights from such source
   of supply in the future under the terms of this act, unless, within one year after
   the effective date of this act, the public water supply agency shall have produced
   to the board the record upon which such acquisition is founded or a statement of the
   facts relied upon to show that such acquisition has been lawfully accomplished, and
   shall have filed in the office of the board, duly certified and acknowledged, transcripts
   of corporate or other action or proceeding, or statement of facts or records relied
   upon as the basis of a claim of acquisition of water rights, and a sworn statement
   of an estimate of the amount of water reasonably necessary from said source of water
   supply for present purposes and future needs, and also such other or additional information
   as the board may deem necessary:  Provided, That prior compliance with the provisions
   of the Act of 1937, Pamphlet Laws 258, Number 64,1by any public water supply agency shall be deemed to be a full meeting of the requirements
   of this section of this act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 22. Water Rights›PA ST 32 P.S. § 634. Determination of validity of claims; water acquisition record; evidence; confirmation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 22. Water Rights › PA ST 32 P.S. § 634. Determination of validity of claims; water acquisition record; evidence; confirmation
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 634. Determination of validity of claims; water acquisition record; evidence; confirmation (2023)
content:
It shall be the duty of the board to consider and to pass upon the validity of the
   claims of public water supply agencies making claim to prior acquisitions of water
   rights under the provisions of section three of this act,1and to notify the claimant of its findings.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 22. Water Rights›PA ST 32 P.S. § 632. Acquisition of water rights not followed by actual taking void
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 22. Water Rights › PA ST 32 P.S. § 632. Acquisition of water rights not followed by actual taking void
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 632. Acquisition of water rights not followed by actual taking void (2023)
content:
Any acquisition of water rights heretofore acquired by any public water supply agency,
   which acquisition has not been followed by an actual taking from the source acquired
   either heretofore or within a period of one year after the effective date of this
   act, is hereby declared null and void and of no effect to the extent required to make
   water rights from such source available for acquisition under the terms of this act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 22. Water Rights›PA ST 32 P.S. § 637. Investigation by board; conflict of interests; approval
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 22. Water Rights › PA ST 32 P.S. § 637. Investigation by board; conflict of interests; approval
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 637. Investigation by board; conflict of interests; approval (2023)
content:
It shall be the duty of the board upon receipt of an application under section six
   of the act,1to make such investigation as may be necessary, including a search of the water acquisition
   record, to determine whether the approval of the application will affect water rights
   theretofore confirmed or approved, or water rights at that time the subject of application
   to the board, or water rights for the acquisition of which a permit shall theretofore
   have been issued.  In case of apparent conflict of interests, the investigation shall include and consider
   the extent of the conservation development and use to the best advantage of existing
   sources of water supply.  In case of established conflict of interests, the board, after receipt of an application
   or at any time or from time to time, shall have the power to issue, modify or impose
   conditions in permits or confirmed claims for, or to the acquisition of, water rights
   theretofore or thereupon issued when deemed necessary by the board in the public interest,
   and it shall be the duty of the board to issue and it shall issue all such permits
   and modification and conditioning orders as the public interest shall require.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 22. Water Rights›PA ST 32 P.S. § 636. Method of acquisition of rights; application for permit; contents
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 22. Water Rights › PA ST 32 P.S. § 636. Method of acquisition of rights; application for permit; contents
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 636. Method of acquisition of rights; application for permit; contents (2023)
content:
Hereafter no acquisition of water rights shall be made or taken by any public water
   supply agency except as follows:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 22. Water Rights›PA ST 32 P.S. § 638. Revocation of permit; failure to take water within four years; extensions of periods; water and rights available for other agencies
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 22. Water Rights › PA ST 32 P.S. § 638. Revocation of permit; failure to take water within four years; extensions of periods; water and rights available for other agencies
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 638. Revocation of permit; failure to take water within four years; extensions of periods; water and rights available for other agencies (2023)
content:
The board shall have the further power to revoke any permit granted under the terms
   of this act in case the water rights are not acquired within one year after the issuance
   of said permit, and said acquisition shall be null and void and of no effect, to the
   extent required to make water and water rights from such source available for acquisition
   under the terms of this act, if any actual taking of water be not made within the
   time specified in the permit not exceeding four years after the issuance of said permit.  If the project required for the taking of water has been commenced in good faith
   or if the commencement thereof has been prevented by events beyond the control of
   the permittee, the board shall have the power, upon application of the permittee,
   to grant such extensions of said period as the board deems to be necessary to enable
   the permittee to complete the project required for the taking of water.  If an actual taking is not made within the time specified in the permit or in any
   extension thereof, the water and water rights covered thereby shall become available
   for acquisition by other public water supply agencies under the terms of this act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 22. Water Rights›PA ST 32 P.S. § 640. Hearings; administration of oaths; record and testimony; appeal; supersedeas
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 22. Water Rights › PA ST 32 P.S. § 640. Hearings; administration of oaths; record and testimony; appeal; supersedeas
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 640. Hearings; administration of oaths; record and testimony; appeal; supersedeas (2023)
content:
Any party or applicant who may be directly or adversely affected by any decision or
   finding of the board under any of the provisions of this act, shall be entitled, upon
   application, to be heard in person or by counsel in a public hearing, on reasonable
   notice, before the board or its duly designated agent.  All members of the board and its duly designated agents shall have power to administer
   oaths to any witness appearing for any party in interest in said hearings.  All testimony and argument shall be recorded and transcribed and shall be read and
   considered by the board before it shall make its decision.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 22. Water Rights›PA ST 32 P.S. § 635. Rights not acquired except as provided in act
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 22. Water Rights › PA ST 32 P.S. § 635. Rights not acquired except as provided in act
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 635. Rights not acquired except as provided in act (2023)
content:
No public water supply agency shall hereafter acquire any water rights except as provided
   in this act, and any acquisition of water rights hereafter, except as provided in
   this act, shall be deemed to be unlawful null and void.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 22. Water Rights›PA ST 32 P.S. § 639. Eminent domain
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 22. Water Rights › PA ST 32 P.S. § 639. Eminent domain
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 639. Eminent domain (2023)
content:
All public water supply agencies heretofore or hereafter incorporated under the laws
   of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania and holding a permit issued by the board under
   the provisions of this act, shall have the power and may exercise the right of eminent
   domain as respects the appropriation of the water and the water rights authorized
   by said permit and land covered by said waters:  Provided, however, That such right
   shall not apply to private spring and private water supplies.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 22. Water Rights›PA ST 32 P.S. § 641. Fees
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 22. Water Rights › PA ST 32 P.S. § 641. Fees
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 641. Fees (2023)
content:
Every statement, record, or application for permit filed under the provisions of this
   act or heretofore filed under the provisions of the act of April 8, 1937, Pamphlet
   Laws 258,1shall be subject to filing fee of twenty-five dollars for the purpose of reimbursing
   the Commonwealth in part for the cost of administration of the act.  All moneys so collected shall be paid into the State Forests and Waters Fund,2by and through the Department of Revenue.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 23. Well Drillers›PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.3. Definitions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 23. Well Drillers › PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.3. Definitions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.3. Definitions (2023)
content:
The following words and phrases, when used in this act, shall have the meaning ascribed
   to them in this section, except where the context clearly indicates a different meaning:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 23. Well Drillers›PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.1. State policy
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 23. Well Drillers › PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.1. State policy
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.1. State policy (2023)
content:
Whereas, underground water in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania is a renewable natural
   resource with a great potential for further development;  and whereas, it is imperative
   that this resource be developed, in an orderly and reasonable manner, without waste,
   in order to assure sufficient supplies for continued population growth and industrial
   development of the Commonwealth.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 23. Well Drillers›PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.4. License required to drill water wells
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 23. Well Drillers › PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.4. License required to drill water wells
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.4. License required to drill water wells (2023)
content:
(a) After the effective date of this act, no person shall drill a water well within
      the Commonwealth, unless he has first secured from the department a license issued
      in such form and subject to such reasonable rules and regulations as the department
      shall prescribe, or unless he is drilling such well within the scope of his employment
      by a licensed well driller.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 23. Well Drillers›PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.8. Suspension or revocation of license; new license
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 23. Well Drillers › PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.8. Suspension or revocation of license; new license
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.8. Suspension or revocation of license; new license (2023)
content:
The department shall have the power to suspend or revoke the license of any water
   well driller, if the same was obtained through error or fraud, for failure to file
   the reports or maintain the records required by the provisions of this act for fraudulent
   operations or for any other violation of this act.  Proceedings shall be conducted in accordance with the provisions of the Administrative
   Agency Law, the act approved the fourth day of June, one thousand nine hundred forty-five
   (Pamphlet Laws 1388).1The department shall have the authority to grant new licenses to persons whose licenses
   have been revoked.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 23. Well Drillers›PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.10. Records and reports
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 23. Well Drillers › PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.10. Records and reports
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.10. Records and reports (2023)
content:
(a) Every licensee shall be required to keep a record of each well upon a form to
      be prescribed by the department, setting forth the exact geographic location and log
      of the well containing a description of materials penetrated, the size and depth,
      the diameters and lengths of casing and screen installed, the static and pumping levels,
      and the yield and such other information pertaining to the construction or operation
      of the well or wells as the department may require, but no water well driller shall
      be required to furnish information as to coal deposits or other valuable minerals.  This record shall be available to the department upon request.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 23. Well Drillers›PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.5. Sealing or filling well
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 23. Well Drillers › PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.5. Sealing or filling well
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.5. Sealing or filling well (2023)
content:
The department may require the well owner to seal effectively or fill any abandoned
   well on his property in accordance with the rules and regulations of the department.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 23. Well Drillers›PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.9. Signature on, and display of, license; possession of drilling rig permit
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 23. Well Drillers › PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.9. Signature on, and display of, license; possession of drilling rig permit
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.9. Signature on, and display of, license; possession of drilling rig permit (2023)
content:
Every person licensed as a water well driller shall write his usual signature with
   pen and ink in the space provided for that purpose on the license issued to him immediately
   upon receipt of such license.  The licensee shall conspicuously display his license at his principal place of business.  The person in charge of each drilling rig shall, at all times, have in his possession,
   when engaged in drilling, the drilling rig permit issued under the provisions of this
   act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 23. Well Drillers›PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.7. Expiration of license
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 23. Well Drillers › PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.7. Expiration of license
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.7. Expiration of license (2023)
content:
Every license and rig permit issued under the provisions of this act shall expire
   on the last day of May next following the date of issue of such license or permit.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 23. Well Drillers›PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.2. Short title
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 23. Well Drillers › PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.2. Short title
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.2. Short title (2023)
content: This act shall be known and may be cited as the “Water Well Drillers License Act”.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 23. Well Drillers›PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.6. Application
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 23. Well Drillers › PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.6. Application
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.6. Application (2023)
content:
(a) Before any water well driller's license is issued, application shall be made,
      in writing, to the department on a form prepared and furnished by the department.  Such application shall contain a statement showing (1) the name of the applicant,
      (2) the business address of the applicant, (3) the residence of the applicant, (4)
      the number of drilling rigs the applicant intends to operate during the license year
      and a short description of each rig, (5) such additional information as the department
      may require.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 23. Well Drillers›PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.11. Penalties
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 23. Well Drillers › PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.11. Penalties
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.11. Penalties (2023)
content:
(a) Summary offense.  Any person who shall drill a well in violation of section four of this act shall,
      upon conviction thereof in a summary proceeding, be sentenced to pay a fine not to
      exceed one hundred dollars ($100.00) and, in default thereof, to suffer imprisonment
      not to exceed ten (10) days.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 23. Well Drillers›PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.12. Effectuating Act; rules and regulations
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 23. Well Drillers › PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.12. Effectuating Act; rules and regulations
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.12. Effectuating Act; rules and regulations (2023)
content:
The department is hereby authorized, empowered and directed to effectuate the provisions
   of this act and to adopt, amend and rescind such reasonable rules and regulations
   as may be necessary to accomplish the purposes of this act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Flood Control Districts›PA ST 32 P.S. § 653. Definitions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Flood Control Districts › PA ST 32 P.S. § 653. Definitions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 653. Definitions (2023)
content:
The word“board,”as used in this act, means the Water and Power Resources Board of the Department
   of Forests and Waters.1

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 24. Prevention and Control of Floods›PA ST 32 P.S. § 652. Appropriation; payment
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 24. Prevention and Control of Floods › PA ST 32 P.S. § 652. Appropriation; payment
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 652. Appropriation; payment (2023)
content:
The sum of three thousand five hundred dollars ($3,500), or so much thereof as may
   be necessary, is hereby specifically appropriated to the Department of Forests and
   Waters1for the payment of all costs and expenses incurred under the provisions of this act,
   including the salaries, compensation, and expenses of persons engaged in making said
   survey, plans, and specifications.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Chapter 23. Well Drillers›PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.13. Fees and other moneys paid into State Treasury; expenditure; appropriation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Chapter 23. Well Drillers › PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.13. Fees and other moneys paid into State Treasury; expenditure; appropriation
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 645.13. Fees and other moneys paid into State Treasury; expenditure; appropriation (2023)
content:
All fees payable under this act and all other moneys received in connection with the
   administration thereof, together with all fines and penalties collected under the
   provisions of this act for violation of the same and all bail forfeited, shall be
   paid into the State Treasury, and shall be credited to the general appropriation of
   the Bureau of Topographic and Geologic Survey in the State Planning Board1for the purpose of administration of this act.  The expenditure of these funds for the administration and enforcement of this act
   is hereby authorized and, for these purposes, such funds are hereby appropriated.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Flood Control Districts›PA ST 32 P.S. § 656. Official plans; notice
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Flood Control Districts › PA ST 32 P.S. § 656. Official plans; notice
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 656. Official plans; notice (2023)
content:
When the board has completed suitable plans, it shall adopt them as official plans
   and give public notice of such adoption in at least two newspapers in each county,
   wholly or partially within such flood control district, if so many are published therein,
   once a week for two consecutive weeks, which notice shall state that the official
   plans are on file in the office of the board.  The board shall also give notice to all persons, whose property may be taken, damaged
   or destroyed in the completion of such plans, by registered mail to the last known
   post office address of the owner or reputed owner of the property.  A certified copy of the completed suitable plans shall, upon their adoption, be
   recorded in the office of the recorder of deeds of each county, wholly or partially
   within a flood control district.  Such recording shall be constructive notice to all owners whose property may be
   taken, damaged or destroyed in the completion of such plans.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks›Part II. Waters›Flood Control Districts›PA ST 32 P.S. § 661. Powers and duties in connection with Federal works and improvements
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 32 P.S. Forests, Waters and State Parks › Part II. Waters › Flood Control Districts › PA ST 32 P.S. § 661. Powers and duties in connection with Federal works and improvements
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 32 P.S. § 661. Powers and duties in connection with Federal works and improvements (2023)
content:
In addition to the powers hereinbefore granted, the board is hereby empowered and
   directed, for and in behalf of the Commonwealth and its subdivisions, to aid, assist,
   and co-operate in the carrying out of any Federal flood control program or plans,
   and for such purposes shall have all of the powers conferred and shall be subject
   to all the limitations imposed by this act, including the approval of plans as provided
   in this act, with respect to the State-created flood control districts and the execution
   of the official plans for such districts, and all other powers consistent therewith,
   necessary or required, in order to enable the Commonwealth to participate in and receive
   the benefits of any Federal flood control program or plans in this Commonwealth, subject
